thought: To log an incident for a hardware issue like a hard drive problem for the user Rick Berzle, I need to fill in the required fields in the incident form. The first step is to set the "Caller" field to Rick Berzle. I will use the search box for the "Caller" field to find and select Rick Berzle. The "Category" should be set to "Hardware" to classify the incident correctly. After that, I will fill in the "Short description" and "Description" fields with relevant details about the hard drive problem.
